subject: Gated onramp milestones — POC environment, API keys & peering (HeliumHealth)
messages:
From: Alex Doe <alex.doe@heliumhealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-08T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: POC onramp & MAP — HeliumHealth evaluation

Hi Grace / team,

Thanks again for the demo last week — we liked the predictable latency profile. We need a short mutual action plan (MAP) and a compact evaluation plan so our infra and security teams can schedule the POC. High level asks from our side:

- Org setup & user roles (who gets access to the eval org)
- Short-lived API keys for the initial 2-week test (scoped to staging only)
- IP allowlist/firewall ranges so we can open egress rules
- VPC peering ribbon for deep integration tests (we'll need a window for the peering cutover)

Can you send a draft MAP with milestones and the network prep checklist? Our preferred start window is Sept 14–17. Also attaching our internal security intake that your team may want to preview.

Thanks,
Alex
Ops Lead — HeliumHealth
(attachment: helium_security_q.pdf)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Doe <alex.doe@heliumhealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-08T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC onramp & MAP — HeliumHealth evaluation

Alex — thanks for the clear list. Attaching a concise MAP workbook and a quick network sketch to get everyone aligned.

What we put in the draft (high-level):
- Milestone 0: Org and IAM onboarding (Day 0–1) — create evaluation org, assign 2 admin seats, my team issues scoped API keys.
- Milestone 1: IP allowlist test (Day 1–3) — you open egress to our documented ranges; we verify connectivity with a smoke test.
- Milestone 2: Prefix cache + basic inference tests (Day 3–7) — run tokenized workloads, perf/latency capture.
- Milestone 3: VPC peering window (Day 8–10) — schedule maintenance window for routing and cross-VPC tests.
- Decision point: Extend or close (Day 11–14) — go/no-go and next steps.

Action items for HeliumHealth: add two staging users to the MAP tab, confirm start date, and accept the peering window options.

Action items for Redwood: prepare ephemeral API keys, publish the exact IP ranges and peering ACLs, and share the peering runbook.

Proposed start: 2026-09-14 (flexible if you need earlier).

I'll hand to Aditya to sketch the exact network ranges and the API key issuance flow (template attached).

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
(attachments: HH_MAP_v0.1.xlsx, hh_network_sketch.png)
From: security@heliumhealth.com <security@heliumhealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Doe <alex.doe@heliumhealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-08T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: HeliumHealth security questionnaire — clarification

Grace — forwarding our security team notes. A few clarifications they asked for:

1) Where will logs for the POC be retained (hosted vs dedicated)? They want retention window and access controls.
2) Will data leave our VPC during the POC? If so, what are the controls (encrypted in transit, KV cache handling)?
3) If we need SOC2 evidence for a short engagement, can you point us to the attestation or a letter?

We'll treat the answers as gating items for the peering approval. Happy to hop on a short call if useful.

—Alex
(attachment: helium_security_q.pdf)

On Tue, Sep 8, 2026 at 09:15 AM Alex Doe <alex.doe@heliumhealth.com> wrote:
> [original message omitted]
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Doe <alex.doe@heliumhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-08T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC onramp & MAP — HeliumHealth evaluation

Thanks — answering security and network points inline and providing the exact tech checklist.

Quick answers:
- Logs: For the hosted MAP POC we'll retain request/response logs in our tenant for 14 days by default; we can extend to 90 days for the Dedicated window but that requires a contract amendment. Access is via role-based access only and we can provide read-only exports on request. (See drive link.)
- Data egress: By default tokens and user text are processed in memory and not persisted beyond the configured log window; transport is TLS 1.3. KV cache stays within the serving node; if you require private deployment/air-gapped we can scope that as a next step.
- SOC2: We can share a redacted SOC2 letter and an evidence summary.

Network & keys (actionable checklist):
1) Redwood will create an eval org and provision two admin users. Please confirm the two emails.
2) We will generate scoped API keys (staging-only, rate-limited). Template attached (redwood_api_key_template.txt). Keys are revocable immediately.
3) IP allowlist: open egress to these CIDR ranges (example list): 34.195.12.0/22, 52.29.0.0/20, 18.204.16.0/20. (We will provide the final list in the runbook.)
4) VPC peering: proposed window 2026-09-13 22:00–23:30 UTC for route swap and connectivity tests. Runbook attached. Please confirm NOC contact and peering-approved CIDRs.

Next steps I suggest: HeliumHealth confirms the two staging users and a preferred peering contact. If you want to move forward we can lock the Sept 13 window and issue keys on Sept 14 morning.

—Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
(attachment: redwood_api_key_template.txt, peering_runbook.pdf)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Doe <alex.doe@heliumhealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-09T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC onramp & MAP — HeliumHealth evaluation (finalize logistics)

Alex — looping our network & NOC contact as requested. Summary and final asks:

Summary table:
- Start: 2026-09-14 (keys issued morning PT)
- Milestone 0 (Org/IAM): 2026-09-14
- IP allowlist verification: 2026-09-14 to 2026-09-15
- Load & perf tests: 2026-09-15 to 2026-09-18
- Peering maintenance window: 2026-09-13 22:00–23:30 UTC (we propose morning keys after the window)

Final asks for HeliumHealth to confirm by EOD 2026-09-10:
1) Two staging user emails for org onboarding.
2) NOC peering contact (name + pager or email).
3) Confirmation you accept the peering window and the IP ranges listed by Aditya.

Our network team contact: network@redwoodinference.com — they'll be on the peering call. If everything looks good we'll treat this MAP as binding for the 2-week evaluation and we will issue the scoped keys once the allowlist check passes.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Marissa Cole
Engagement Manager, Redwood Inference
